title: Trump presents a 20-point plan to end the Gaza war alongside Netanyahu
body:
On Monday 29 September 2025, US President Donald Trump presented a 20-point plan to end the war in Gaza at a White House news conference with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Trump said the sides were beyond very close to ending the war and called it a historic day for peace. Netanyahu said he supported the plan because it achieves Israel's war aims. Trump said Israel would have US backing to act if Hamas rejected the plan.

Al Jazeera summarised the main terms. All Israeli captives would be released within 72 hours of Israel accepting the agreement, after which Israel would free 250 Palestinians serving life sentences and 1,700 people from Gaza detained since 7 October 2023. Israel would not occupy or annex Gaza and no one would be forced to leave. Israeli forces would withdraw to agreed lines, the UN would supervise immediate humanitarian aid, and an international stability force would be deployed. A Board of Peace chaired by Trump, with figures such as former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair, would oversee a technocratic administration. Hamas members who accepted coexistence would receive amnesty, and a reformed Palestinian Authority could eventually take a role.

Trump said Netanyahu was clear in opposing a Palestinian state. Hamas official Mahmoud Mardawi told Al Jazeera Mubasher the group had not yet received the written plan. Netanyahu also apologised to Qatar for the Israeli strikes on Hamas negotiators in Doha on 9 September.
